_about: What each skill level does in numbers, shown by the wiki (tools/build_wiki.py folds it into data/wiki.json). Curated 2026-10-12 from the game data (data/datamine, notes/skill_params_datamine.md), data/damage_model.json, notes/skill_values_*.md, kiranico and community tests. Units as the game words them: attack as in skill texts, element in display units. confidence: high = data and an independent check agree, medium = one source or inferred meaning, low = single secondary source. text: the game's per-level wording with the exact numbers (vague words such as "temporarily" or "greatly" replaced), only where it differs from the game; written 2026-10-13 from the levels lines, it replaces the game text in the app (data/skills.json) and the wiki.

text.2: Allows you to perform the special action: The Blackest Night. It grants a shield for 8 s, with a cooldown of about 70 s.
